comparisons.peer_summary: A relatively small number of customers account for significant portions of net revenue, with sales to distributors comprising 48% and 57% of net revenue in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively. The top five end customers accounted for approximately 40% and 35% of net revenue in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, and the loss of any of these customers could have a material adverse effect on the business.
comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and AVGO disclose significant customer concentration risk where a small number of customers account for a large portion of consolidated net revenue. QCOM specifies that Apple, Samsung, and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of its revenues in fiscal 2024. AVGO reports that its top five end customers accounted for approximately 40% of its net revenue in fiscal 2024, and also highlights that sales to distributors comprised 48% of that revenue, indicating a different channel structure but similar exposure to key customer relationships.
